Messaging Developer
United States
Full-time
Remote
Entry Level
$68K/yr - $75K/yr
1–3 years exp
Dentsu hires a Messaging Developer to prepare and deploy HTML and text email content and integrate it dynamically into a proprietary email delivery platform. The role develops, quality-checks, and deploys email campaigns while coordinating assets and maintaining accurate, timely production.
Advertising
Information Technology
Marketing
Information Services
Responsibilities
Develop complex and customized HTML email code that follows industry best practices and brand guidelines and reflects the original creative design as closely as possible
Apply dynamic content rules and configure link tracking
Perform quality assurance on dynamic emails through self-audits and peer checks
Content change management
Link tracking and email deployment using proprietary email platform
Upload HTML/Text content to email platform
Work with email account production managers to coordinate campaign assets
Provide error-free final list deployments
Meet deadlines for content publication
Demonstrate flexibility by adapting to the evolving needs and priorities of our clients
Maintain basic knowledge of data as it relates to HTML code, to aid in troubleshooting critical list errors
Keep up with industry standards, innovations, and new best practices in email marketing
Maintain basic knowledge of list processing and can troubleshoot any potential list errors
Maintain error free, On-time HTML code while adhering to the standard process and best practices of the team
Error free; On-time; Adherence to standard processes and best practice, yet flexible and adaptive; Responsive to team and client needs; Production of work in a timely fashion; Completion of work with attention to details; Utilization of auditing processes and techniques

Required
* Basic to Intermediate knowledge of HTML and CSS
* Experience in responsive design is required
* Ability to deliver high-quality work with minimal supervision
* Ability to prioritize work according to a variety of factors and variables
* Ability to conceptualize and communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* One to three years of experience in front-end development or email marketing in a professional environment
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or comparable technical field, or professional experience that demonstrates comparable technical abilities required
* Experience building error-free email campaigns, including responsive HTML emails
* Familiarity with email testing and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid
* Basic to Intermediate understanding of web languages and development tools such as HTML, CSS, Photoshop, Figma, Dreamweaver, Visual Studio, and Bootstrap
* Strong work ethic and a bias toward action- and results-oriented activities
* Clear, friendly communication with teammates and clients
* Collaborator that is team-centric and understands the importance of client service
* Naturally proactive and highly organized with the ability to turnaround multiple complex projects quickly
Preferred
* Technical understanding of platform-specific scripting languages and/or JavaScript is a plus
* Familiarity with large language models (LLMs) and AI tools is a plus
* Experience communicating with internal teams as a primary point of contact a plus
* Experience working in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) preferred
Other ESP experience (e.g., Adobe Campaign, Braze, Oracle Responsys, Oracle Eloqua) a plus
Benefits
Medical, vision, and dental insurance
Life insurance
Short-term and long-term disability insurance
401k
Flexible paid time off
At least 15 paid holidays per year
Paid sick and safe leave
Paid parental leave
Hybrid way of working combines remote flexibility with regular in-person collaboration; employees within commuting distance (90 minutes) of a Headquarter or Hub Office may be required to work in the office 2-3 days per week, including one Team Day. Those who do not live near an office may be designated as a remote employee, depending on the role and business needs.
